snippet.title: Blight: Survival Deep Dive - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Our first Ones to Watch deep dive of the Spring Showcase centred on Haenir Studio's Blight: Survival, a PvE co-operative horror game where you take down monsters with medieval weaponry. It's coming soon to PC, and you can sign up to the official discord for information on upcoming playtests.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1774880/Blight_Survival/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
